_comment: THE FOUNDER'S PLAYBOOK — periodical harvest config. Add future companies by editing THIS data, not periodical_harvest.py. Every endpoint/parameter below was verified against a live call or an archived REAL response (see HARVEST_README.md verification log). CA = chroniclingamerica.loc.gov OpenSearch params (andtext, date1, date2, dateFilterType, state, sort, page, format=json) per official API docs; date format YYYYMMDD or YYYY.

params.q: "Walton's" store AND mediatype:texts AND YEAR:[1945 TO 1965]
walton (retailing OR "variety store" OR "five and dime") AND mediatype:texts AND YEAR:[1945 TO 1965]

tasks._note: REFERENCE EXEMPLAR OF A HIT. Verified live 2026-09-24: this exact param set returns numFound=27, the printed Wal-Mart Stores FY1972-FY1997 annual-report run that flipped the Walmart depth verdict from forensic-core to exemplar (company_002_walmart/research/B_periodical_retest.md). The original probe had declared pre-IPO financials undocumented while never querying digitised books or bound corporate print.
Tests the documented gap: FY1970/FY1971 reports are absent from IA (retest WR-16). A numFound=0 here is a null on THESE PARAMS, not on the family.
identifier taken verbatim from the live search response above; metadata call reports server/dir and the *_djvu.txt text layer.

tasks.query_label: CP FY1972 AR full text (direct server)
tasks._note: server/dir/file copied verbatim from a live archive.org/metadata response on 2026-09-24 (that URL returned HTTP 200 / 23,989 B of the audited FY1968-FY1972 five-year table). archive.org/download/ 302s to a CDN with an expired TLS cert in this environment, hence the content-server route.

params.q: "charter med" AND mediatype:texts AND YEAR:[1971 TO 1985]

tasks._note: Family 5 seeded for UnitedHealth: the company printed shareholder reports from its 1977 Charter Med founding / 1984 IPO onward. Title-scoped form verified live 2026-09-24 (HTTP 200, numFound=0 for these params).

creator: is the productive clause for bound corporate print (proved on the Apple seed, where creator:("apple computer") retrieved corporate print that title-scoping missed). creator verified as a queryable and returnable field live 2026-09-24.

Apple's early-era printed corporate material is the SAME CLASS OF EVIDENCE that flipped Walmart; Apple's probe left 'money and organisation' as the exclusion. Title-scoped form verified live 2026-09-24: numFound=0 in 1976-1990 (per-param null only).

tasks.query_label: CP apple corporate print by creator 1976-1995
tasks._note: VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-24 as a POSITIVE form: creator:("apple computer") AND (title:(annual) OR title:(report)) AND mediatype:(texts) AND YEAR:[1976 TO 1995] returned numFound=5, Apple Computer, Inc.-authored corporate research print dated 1989 (identifiers micro_IA41155142_0546..0550).

tasks.query_label: CP text availability apple 1989 corporate report
tasks._note: identifier verbatim from the live creator-scoped search above; establishes whether a text layer exists before anyone claims the item is unread.

_corporate_print_reference_exemplar._what_it_proves: Family 5 is the family that REVERSED a depth verdict. The complete printed Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. annual-report run FY1972-FY1997 sits on Internet Archive with text layers, free; the probe that rated Walmart 'forensic-core' had asserted 'pre-IPO financials are UNDOCUMENTED at Tier 1' and 'annual-report text = paper, not EDGAR' without ever querying digitised books or bound corporate print. See founders_playbook/01_companies/company_002_walmart/research/B_periodical_retest.md.

reference_hit.verified_query: (title:(walmart) OR title:("wal-mart stores")) AND (title:(annual) OR title:(reports) OR title:(yearbook)) AND mediatype:(texts) AND YEAR:[1970 TO 1998]

example_item.title: 1972 Annual Report For Walmart Stores Inc

_corporate_print_reference_exemplar.field_verification: title:/creator:/mediatype:/YEAR:[a TO b] clauses and fl[] return fields confirmed by live advancedsearch calls; server/dir/files[].name/metadata.{title,date,year} confirmed by a live archive.org/metadata/<id> call. NOTHING in this family uses an unverified parameter.
known_query_traps: title:("wal-mart") does NOT match an item titled 'Walmart Stores' — hyphen/quote tokenisation is unreliable, so always OR the hyphenless form.

Unscoped conjunctions (walmart AND "annual report" AND YEAR:[..]) return token noise (CIA reading-room documents, Compute! magazine). numFound>0 from such a query is NOT evidence — that is WR-17 of the Walmart retest.
archive.org/download/<id>/<file> 302s to a CDN whose TLS certificate is expired from this network; use the server+dir route recorded above.
